channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Mamdani Says Child Was in Car When ICE Agent Shot New York Man
item.description: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent shot and wounded a man in New York City on Thursday, prompting Mayor Zohran Mamdani to demand an end to ICE operations in the city.

item.title: Malaysia PM Calls Prabowo Over Haze as Kuala Lumpur Chokes
item.description: Malaysia’s prime minister has contacted Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto about efforts to tackle the thick smog that has choked Kuala Lumpur and other parts of the country as weeks of devastating wildfires consume swathes of the neighboring archipelago.

item.title: UK Police Arrest Latvian Men Found at Second Airbase Used by US
item.description: British police arrested two men on suspicion of trespassing and national security offenses at an airbase that’s used by the US for intelligence and analysis work, just weeks after a suspected terror plot at another base that was home to American bombers.

item.title: What is PERM? Why Trump suspended Microsoft and Indian IT firms from green-card programme
item.description: Vice President JD Vance announced the move on Thursday (October 8), accusing companies of using foreign-worker programmes at the expense of US employees.

item.title: Palm oil producers eye closer India ties: Why the world’s biggest vegetable oil importer matters
item.description: The message emerging from GLOBOIL India 2026 was that the relationship between India and global edible oil producers is becoming more strategic.

item.title: GST Council approves concept note for optional quarterly tax payment for small businesses
item.description: Under the proposed scheme, eligible businesses would be required to file only one annual return while making tax payments on a quarterly basis

item.title: Trump says US, Iran in ‘productive’ talks, rules out attack before midterm polls in November
item.description: The conflict erupted in February after the US and Israel carried out strikes on Iran. The prolonged war has hurt Trump's approval ratings at home and created political pressure on Republicans, who are trying to retain their slim majorities in Congress in the upcoming elections.

item.title: 'Maintaining public order': Delhi liquor shops closed on October 9-10 as CJP plans protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: Delhi will shut all retail liquor shops on October 9 and 10 as a preventive measure amid heightened political activity and the CJP's planned October 10 protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Security has also been tightened across the capital.

item.title: Two months after Meta fiasco, Meity advisory claims public order at risk
item.description: The government has told social media platforms to be more careful about misleading, manipulated and out-of-context content that could disrupt public order.&nbsp;

item.title: FSSAI send notices to Dr Reddy's, Nestle Health Science, Amazon, Flipkart over misleading protein supplement
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has sent notices to companies, including Dr Reddy's and Nestle Health Science, regarding products which can possibly mislead consumers regarding its health benefits. It issued notices for non-compliant advertising and misleading claims.

item.title: Nandini plans 120 new Bengaluru parlours after Amul metro row: What's behind the expansion
item.description: Karnataka Milk Federation plans 120 new Nandini parlours in Bengaluru, including 30 outside Metro stations and 90 within GBA limits. The expansion follows the 2025 Amul kiosk row and aims to bring Nandini products closer to consumers.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi reacts to Elon Musk's ‘Is Ambani the real boss of India?’: Here's a look at their conversation on X
item.description: The exchange came hours after the Ministry of Communications rejected Musk’s allegations that vested interests were blocking Starlink’s plans in India, saying all satellite communication companies were subject to the same regulatory requirements.

item.title: Saudi Arabia-Houthi conflict: Indian Embassy in Riyadh issues advisory; Air India, IndiGo, Akasa cancel flights
item.description: The advisory comes as Houthi attacks have increasingly targeted Saudi airports and other civilian and energy infrastructure.

item.title: US suspends work visa program for Indian IT firms, Microsoft citing widespread abuse
item.description: Indian IT firms, including TCS, Infosys, Wipro and HCLTech, are among the tech firms suspended from the Permanent Labor Certification Program.

item.title: GST Council clears big procedural overhaul, keeps rates largely unchanged
item.description: The GST Council approved reforms to make compliance faster and more predictable for businesses.&nbsp;

item.title: Child's ₹1.5 lakh annual school fees, ₹1 lakh family income: Snabbit director on woman gig worker’s ₹40K earnings impact
item.description: A Snabbit worker earning ₹30,000– ₹40,000 monthly helped her family afford her child’s ₹1.5 lakh-a-year school fees. Together with her auto-driver husband, she now brings in around ₹80,000– ₹1 lakh a month, according to a company executive.

item.title: US suspends Microsoft, Infosys, Wipro, and other tech firms from green-card programme: ‘Stop defrauding American worker’
item.description: The move comes amid Trump administration’s broader focus on prioritising US workers and scrutinising programmes used by companies to employ foreign nationals.

item.title: New GRAP Rules in Delhi; Restrictions in NCR October 2026: How AQI will decide car entry - Where to check updates daily
item.description: Under the revised GRAP framework, restrictions tighten as Delhi-NCR’s AQI worsens. Stage III limits certain BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel cars, while Stage IV adds stricter curbs. Check daily AQI and GRAP status via SAMEER and CAQM.

item.title: Jantar Mantar protests demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation: Delhi orders liquor shops shut on October 9-10
item.description: The Delhi government has ordered the closure of retail liquor shops across the national capital citing the “prevailing situation” and inputs from the Delhi Police as a precautionary measure to maintain public order.

item.title: Laid off techie paid ₹92 lakh tax last year, now struggling to find ₹90 lakh yearly job: 'Leaving India soon'
item.description: The engineer claimed that he paid ₹92 lakh in income tax to the Indian government during the previous financial year.

item.title: India aims to be self-reliant in shipping and shipbuilding by 2047: Sonowal
item.description: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal said the government is building an ecosystem to help domestic shipyards win global orders as India targets a spot among the world's top five shipbuilding nations.

item.title: Geopolitics, China, and AI to test India’s 2047 ambitions: CEA Nageswaran
item.description: India must prepare for a tougher path to developed-economy status by 2047, the chief economic adviser said, citing five forces reshaping its prospects: geopolitics, supply-chain dependencies, China’s industrial scale, climate volatility, and AI alongside demographic change.

item.title: ‘They’re paid by enemies of our nation’: Trump lashes out at protesters amid Texas rally interruptions
item.description: Trump responded angrily to the interruptions, accusing the protesters of being paid by “enemies of our nation”. “Get the hell out of here,” Trump told protesters as the disruptions continued.

item.title: Monsoon withdrawal advances as India records one of its weakest seasons in decades
item.description: IMD sees further withdrawal over the next three to four days, even as rain persists across parts of eastern, northeastern and southern India

item.title: Mint Explainer: What do we know about Russia’s suspected plague outbreak?
item.description: A Siberian lab worker's death has triggered hundreds of quarantines and global monitoring, though Russian officials deny a pneumonic plague outbreak and WHO assesses the risk as low.

item.title: Ayodhya's Ram Mandir to get FSSAI 'Eat Right Place' tag, says report; here's how the certification works
item.description: Ayodhya’s Ram Temple will reportedly receive FSSAI’s ‘Eat Right Place’ recognition after an assessment of food safety, hygiene and quality standards for prasad. The consumer protection authority fined e-commerce platform ₹1 lakh for allegedly selling sweets misleadingly described as temple prasad.

item.title: 42 retired judges in open letter defend Election Commission amid SIR row: 'Calculated campaign without evidence'
item.description: The retired judges alleged that constitutional institutions in India are facing a sustained attack, with the Election Commission being a key target of the criticism.

item.title: India-EU green shipping corridor: Why India could become a major fuel exporter
item.description: India could emerge as a major green-fuel exporter as it works with European partners to develop a green shipping corridor. Industry leaders at Sagarmanthan 2026 said India’s renewable energy potential, green fuel ecosystem, and port infrastructure could make it a key supplier to global shipping.

item.title: Unmanned frontline: From combat to high-risk evacuations, how robots are replacing troops in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: Unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) are reshaping the Russia-Ukraine war, taking on combat, logistics, ammunition delivery and casualty evacuation missions. Ukraine is expanding four-wheeled and tracked robots, with some units aiming to replace a third of frontline troops with unmanned systems.

item.title: Who is Anne Carson? Canadian writer and poet wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature for her ‘bold and inventive oeuvre’
item.description: Canadian poet and writer Anne Carson has won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature for an inventive body of work that reimagines classical traditions and creates new literary forms. Her writing blends poetry, prose, essays, criticism, translation &amp; fiction, drawing on ancient texts and modern thinkers.

item.title: Microfinance shows early recovery signs, but legacy bad loans weigh on sector
item.description: After two years of stress, micro-lenders tightened credit and reduced high-risk multiple borrowing, while repayment performance improved in FY26. The sector’s loan book, however shrank, and legacy defaults worsened.&nbsp;

item.title: Direct fund transfers helped save govt ₹5 lakh crore from leakages, PM Modi says at India Mobile Congress | Here's how
item.description: At India Mobile Congress, PM Modi said Direct Benefit Transfer helped prevent nearly ₹5 lakh crore from going into leakages. He explained how direct transfers to beneficiaries’ bank accounts reduced the scope for funds being diverted under the old system.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says 3 killed in airport attacks claimed by Houthis, vows strikes ‘will not go unpunished’ | What we know
item.description: Saudi Arabia said three people were killed in airport attacks claimed by the Houthis, with strikes reported in Riyadh and Abha. The kingdom has vowed retaliation as fighting intensifies in Yemen, raising concerns over security around the strategic Bab el-Mandeb route.

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay’s assets row: ‘ ₹30 crore not disclosed, will it matter to voters?’ — All about case in Madras HC
item.description: The Madras High Court questioned whether non-disclosure of assets worth ₹30 crore by Chief Minister Joseph Vijay in his election nomination papers would amount to “corrupt practice.”

item.title: 'Zero transparency, zero accountability from EC', alleges YouTuber Dhruv Rathee addressing SIR protest in Bengaluru
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee accused the Election Commission of lacking transparency and accountability over the SIR exercise at a protest in Bengaluru. Actor-activist Prakash Raj called for the exercise to be scrapped, saying it threatened citizens’ rights and dignity.
